kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انسرحت (form VII)
# اِنْسَرَحْتُ (insaraḥtu) /in.sa.raħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# اِنْسَرَحْتَ (insaraḥta) /in.sa.raħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# اِنْسَرَحْتِ (insaraḥti) /in.sa.raħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# اِنْسَرَحَتْ (insaraḥat) /in.sa.ra.ħat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
